    Reduction of path categories and mesh relations along a ring map #

    For a ring map red : 𝒪 → k, reduction of coefficients on the linear path categories (redP): it preserves composition, paths and degrees, sends the mesh relations of coefficients ũ to those of c when red ∘ ũ = c, maps the mesh ideal into the mesh ideal, and (for surjective red) every element of the mesh ideal over k lifts to one over 𝒪. This is the right exactness used in Lemma B.2 ("Right exactness of tensor product gives coker D_m(E₄) ⊗ 𝔽₂ ≅ coker D_m(C⁽²⁾)").

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
